issues.message: CHK-001 userSees may be too abstract (does not contain specific output text in quotes). Should describe the exact text the user sees, not descriptions like "feature works correctly"

missing_original_intent_snapshot: Intent MVP requires original_intent_snapshot_set with sourceText, normalizedOutcome, and acceptanceClaim. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

missing_intent_collision: Intent collision is triggered but no pass decision with acceptedInterpretation is present. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

CHK-001 missing verificationIntent.happy. The second-generation flow preserves happy/edge/adversarial test discipline: write intent in PLAN, cover via verification_evidence_add or validate in DEV/TEST.

CHK-001 missing verificationIntent.edge. The second-generation flow preserves happy/edge/adversarial test discipline: write intent in PLAN, cover via verification_evidence_add or validate in DEV/TEST.

CHK-001 missing verificationIntent.adversarial. The second-generation flow preserves happy/edge/adversarial test discipline: write intent in PLAN, cover via verification_evidence_add or validate in DEV/TEST.
High-risk stories must have plan.md (execution plan). Write it following the plan.md template in CLAUDE.md, one section per CHK-xxx

missing_scope_check: scope-check.json is missing PLAN gate evidence. Start a story-level PLAN scope reviewer with `proof-or-stop dispatch --storyId=B-42f6 --agentType=proof-or-stop-review-scope-plan`; dispatch output is not gate evidence, and the proof-or-stop-review-scope-plan / scope-plan reviewer must finish by calling `proof-or-stop scope_check_save`. The implementation/main agent must not self-sign this evidence or manually edit story metadata. Local CLI guidance is not remote completion and must not be presented as receipt verification or production/full completion.
